name: Hatred
notes: Known from one sample roleplay posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy on 12 January 1998, titled "BBWF sample RP (Please tell me what you think)", served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/bbwf-sample-rp-please-tell-me-what-you-think-1998-01-12.html: a hooded figure in a castle tower who reveals a face and head covered in claw-mark scars, says he was the wrestler known as Thrasher and has remade himself as Hatred, the most dreaded thing in the world, introduces his partner Greed and names Stargazer and Pyscotron among the first on his list of casualties.
caption: The scarred former Thrasher who emerges in a castle tower to announce himself as Hatred in January 1998.

tenures.source: /promotions/rspwf/archive/bbwf-sample-rp-please-tell-me-what-you-think-1998-01-12.html (the sample roleplay, in which he says he has been in the BBWF about two months)

name: Greed
notes: Known from one sample roleplay posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy on 12 January 1998, served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/bbwf-sample-rp-please-tell-me-what-you-think-1998-01-12.html: a monstrous silent giant with arms like tree trunks, formerly the Stranger, who stands with arms crossed beside Hatred and is said to be greedy for the BBWF World Heavyweight Title.
caption: The silent tree-armed giant, once the Stranger, who stands beside Hatred in January 1998.
